Sometime after the [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]] established a colony on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]], an '''ecological disaster''' struck their [[Morodin homeworld|homeworld]]. The event resulted in the Morodins being unable to grow their [[organic space vessel]]s, which led to the colony on Varonat being cut off from the homeworld.
